reviews.title: SHOCKED but update included!
reviews.body: UPDATE: So I am encountering a STRANGE problem. As I stated before - I’m experiencing a breakout from extreme sweating. That was about 3 weeks ago and it is taking so long to clear up. I’ve never experienced this. It’s frustrating, I feel insecure. I don’t know if I chose the worst possible time to try this product or if it’s just my personal healing experience? Again, first time, Im not exactly sure how to handle this. However - what’s STRANGE and this is going to sound so bizarre. I’m not taking away stars from my review. I feel like, somehow, this wash along with the zero pore pads have shrunken the pores between my eyebrows and nose SO much that the gunk underneath is trapped. I’m a picker. And I’ve tried to control myself - but I just want it GONE you know? So i’m trying to squeeze.. there is no pore for it to escape from. So then I burst blood vessels. And it only makes it worse. SO I’m going to use all self control and not pick. Surprise, I did just this morning, prolonging this. I’m adding this to my review because - if I had not had this breakout prior, if I let it heal while withholding from this product, does it mean that when healthy skin is back, this shrinking of pores will leave me a glass skin queen? Or will things forever be trapped? BECAUSE the products are working so well? I am stuck in a cycle. I will update once I get this breakout cleared. I may be reviewing into the void but this feels like a science experiment and unfortunately I am the experiment.Important to note: I am now exclusively using this face wash, the mild zero pore pads, PDRN salmon toner, PDRN hyaluronic acid serum, PDRN salmon exosome shot 1-3 times a week, PDRN salmon moisturizer in morning and the jelly cream at night.ORIGINAL REVIEW:My photos are a before and after of the FIRST wash. Firstly, My skin is combination (more on the dry side) with an oily T-zone and I am not normally acne prone nor do I have sensitive skin. (My forehead has never broken out like this and its from sweating while mowing the lawn YAY). I am a first time Medicube user. I did a LOT of looking around before I took the chance on this product.I am the type to dispense way more product than I usually need but I fought the urge and used less than normal and it really does literally does just take a little bigger than a pea size to cover your whole face. That’s a BIG (and surprising) bonus to me because it means this will bottle will last awhile! It suds up nice and feels luxuriously smooth. I made sure to rub it around for atleast 60 seconds.  After rinsing off, I don’t feel dry or stripped or irritated. Just really clean. The scent is mild.I also got the Zero Pore pads (mild because the other was sold out but I’ll just try to get it when I run out of these). In conjunction, I think they work really well. I’ve always had large pores/blackheads on the side of my nose, on my nose, between my eyebrows, and on my chin. I am so shocked at how much they were cleaned out it’s almost like I can feel the air hit my skin better if that makes sense LOL. After every wash I am still shocked at how clear my pores are.I use Cerave hydrating toner after the pore pads but I’m in an experimenting era and plan on getting more Medicube products especially after the results of this face wash! I think this is a GREAT morning/night wash. Start the day off with fresh clean pores. End the night by cleaning out what built up over the day. (Many mornings I don’t wash my face and just use Garnier SkinActive Hyaluronic acid + aloe cleansing micellar water with toner. With this breakout I have been avoiding moisturizer in all these steps because I felt it was making it worse).My reviews are always all over the place and probably has unsolicited advice but I hope this helps someone. For the price, this is worth the try! Bye!

reviews.title: A product that does what it says!? This is it!
reviews.body: Medicube's Zero Pore Capsule Cleansing Foam does exactly what it says! I have some larger pores in my T-zone, especially on my nose. I'm super skeptical about any skincare product - from spending money on multiple high-dollar products that claim they're the next latest & greatest skincare product - that does nothing but empty your wallet. Medicube is different - it WORKS! Even better it's affordable!After just one use of the Zero Pore Capsule Cleansing Foam, my nose pores appeared significantly clearer (didn't look as dark) and there were fewer visible. (I think it's because they were smaller and were cleaned out)I'm mid 50's and have fair to light/medium skin that's also sensitive & reactive, along with rosacea. The description says suitable for all skin types and gentle enough for daily use. I always carry out a patch test on the inside of my elbow and have yet to react to any Medicube product. This cleanser lathers well, the fragrance is nice and it doesn't leave the skin dried out.I would definitely recommend this item to others and I will buy again. So happy to have found Medicube!!

reviews.title: Finally Clear, Smooth Skin After Years of Pimples & Oily Skin!
reviews.body: The MediCube Zero Pore Capsule Cleansing Foam has honestly been a miracle product for me. Ever since puberty, I’ve struggled with constant little pimples, clogged pores, whiteheads, and oily skin. Even without makeup, I would wake up with new pimples almost every single day no matter how carefully I washed my face morning and night.This cleanser completely changed my skin.My skin is now smoother than it has EVER been in my life. The biggest improvement is definitely the texture. My face feels soft, clean, and much more balanced. It didn’t clear my acne 100%, but I would honestly say it improved my skin by around 65–70%, which is the best my skin has ever looked.What shocked me most was how quickly it worked. After just ONE wash, I could already see a difference. Around 40–50% of my whiteheads looked reduced, and blackheads became much easier to remove. After about 3 weeks, my skin looked dramatically clearer.I also use the MediCube Azelaic Acid Cleansing Foam, which has helped prevent new breakouts and works wonderfully with this cleanser. Together, they’ve been a game changer for my oily, acne-prone skin.A few things I love:* A tiny amount creates a LOT of foam* Very affordable for how little product you need* Helps remove blackheads and whiteheads* Controls oil without making my skin feel stripped* My oil/water balance feels so much healthier nowBefore using this, my face would get oily again only about 2 hours after washing. Now my skin stays fresh much longer without feeling overly dry.One thing to note: this cleanser is strong. When I used it every day morning and night, the skin around my lips became a little dry, itchy, and sensitive. Once my acne got under control, I started using it only about twice a week, and that works perfectly for me now. I also use it on my chest and back for body acne.If you have sensitive skin, I would recommend trying the gentler foam version or the azelaic acid cleanser first. But for super oily skin with clogged pores and pimples, this cleanser is AMAZING.I also appreciate that the ingredients are Yuka-approved with no harmful ingredients.I genuinely did not expect such a huge difference from a face wash, but MediCube completely changed my skin. I’ll definitely keep using this brand from now on!
